name: Agent Zero
description: Autonomous AI assistant with full Linux access, persistent memory, web browsing, and multi-agent task delegation.

env.label: Chat Model Provider
env.description: LLM provider for the chat model

env.label: Chat Model Name
env.description: Model name to use (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-20250514, llama3)

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: OpenAI API key (required if using OpenAI provider)

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: Anthropic API key (required if using Anthropic provider)

env.label: Google AI API Key
env.description: Google AI API key (required if using Google provider)

env.label: Groq API Key
env.description: Groq API key; can also be configured in the Web UI under Settings

env.label: Mistral API Key
env.description: Mistral AI API key; can also be configured in the Web UI under Settings

env.label: OpenRouter API Key
env.description: OpenRouter API key; can also be configured in the Web UI under Settings

env.label: DeepSeek API Key
env.description: DeepSeek API key; can also be configured in the Web UI under Settings

env.label: Hugging Face API Token
env.description: Hugging Face access token; can also be configured in the Web UI under Settings

env.label: Utility Model Provider
env.description: LLM provider for the utility/helper model

env.label: Utility Model Name
env.description: Model name for utility tasks (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku)

env.label: Embedding Model Provider
env.description: Provider for the text embedding model used by memory
